name: cairn-builtin-java
description: Built-in Java registry pack bundled with the Cairn reference compiler. DataVersions come from Mojang release notes (no `--reports` extraction yet). The per-version block tables come from PrismarineJS/minecraft-data (data/pc/{1.20.4,1.21.1,1.21.4}/blocks.json, retrieved 2026-08-12); 1.21.1 is the patch release of the 1.21 line. The `aliases` groups are hand-written: the spellings one block has worn, so a refused id can be answered with the name this target does use. They cover the Java/Bedrock spelling splits an author most often walks into and the ids Bedrock's own 1.21.40 flattening wave retired. Two cases are deliberately absent, both because a group is keyed on the spelling alone: a spelling both editions declare meaning different blocks (`snow`), and the numbered pre-flattening slab ids, whose old name carries the family in a state value rather than in the id.
